tagline: Protecting businesses from evolving cyberthreats with an AI-powered cybersecurity platform
hero_kpi_rationale: Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) is the primary indicator of structural growth for NABL, reflecting the sustainable adoption of its SaaS platform and its scalable business model in the cybersecurity segment for SMBs and MSPs.

kpis.name: Annual Recurring Revenue
kpis.explanation: Annual recurring revenue generated from subscriptions to the software platform.
kpis.description: ARR measures annual recurring subscription revenue, excluding credits and reserves. It includes both long-term and monthly contracts.
kpis.signal: Strong ARR growth driven by demand and a strategic acquisition.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by the company's activities during a quarter.
kpis.description: Total revenue for the quarter ended December 31, 2024, driven by subscriptions and the long-term contract initiative.
kpis.signal: Sustained double-digit quarterly growth fueled by the shift toward long-term contracts.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating profit, excluding non-recurring items and amortization.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA remains high and stable, reflecting strong operational discipline despite increasing investments.
kpis.signal: Stable profitability despite rising operating costs.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Total headcount as of December 31, 2024, up from 1,773 a year earlier.
kpis.signal: Moderate workforce expansion to support growth.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue.

kpis.name: R&D Investments
kpis.explanation: Spending on research and development in absolute terms.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on physical or technological assets for the business.

kpis.name: Customers with ARR > $50K
kpis.explanation: Number of customers generating annual recurring revenue above $50,000.
kpis.description: Key indicator of customer portfolio quality and ability to monetize relationships with MSPs.
kpis.signal: Rapid growth in high-volume customers, signaling retention and expansion.

kpis.name: Share of Customers >$50K in Total ARR
kpis.explanation: Proportion of total annual recurring revenue generated by customers with ARR > $50K.
kpis.description: The share of ARR from customers >$50K increased from 57% to 61%, indicating a more profitable customer base.
kpis.signal: Improvement in revenue quality with greater concentration among large customers.

risks.title: High and volatile effective tax rate
risks.score_rationale: Risk is highlighted in the Income Tax Expense section with strong language: the effective tax rate surges to 812.3% in 2025 versus 43.0% in 2024, driven by non-deductible losses in the US. This extreme volatility directly impacts profitability. The Capital category is heavily weighted here.

risks.title: Dependence on long-term contracts
risks.score_rationale: The text repeatedly mentions the impact of the Long-Term Contract Initiative on revenue retention, with net retention declining from 110% (2023) to 103% (2024-2025). The language signals clear pressure on growth dynamics, suggesting risky dependence on these contracts.

risks.title: Sharp increase in cloud infrastructure costs
risks.score_rationale: Cloud infrastructure and hosting expense increased by 14.4M in 2025, representing a major driver of the 45.1% rise in cost of revenue. The text emphasizes this increase as the primary cause, with explicit and repeated language.

risks.title: Integration of recent acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: The acquisition of Adlumin (November 2024) is cited as the cause of increased amortization (+13.4M) and interest expense tied to deferred debt. This is a new risk linked to future costs and technology integration complexity.

risks.title: Sensitivity to variable interest rates
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly states that borrowings are at variable rates and rate fluctuations impact results. While the effect is partially offset in 2025, the risk is recurring and documented in the Interest Expense section.

risks.title: Geographic revenue concentration
risks.score_rationale: Approximately 50% of revenue originates from the US, and 10% from the UK. While the text does not directly label this as a risk, this concentration is flagged as a recurring structural fact, with moderate weighting for the Geopolitical category.

ai_positioning.summary: NABL integrates AI as a core component of its cybersecurity platform to enhance threat detection and operational efficiency, without positioning it as a central marketing message. AI is used to improve critical security outcomes.
evidence: Platform described as 'AI-powered' in the MD&A
AI used to improve critical security outcomes
Clear functional positioning integrated into the platform
